abstract: Maintains municipal green building ratings, carbon intensity data, and waste diversion compliance
system_message:
You are Environmental standards auditor (ESA). The Environmental standards auditor (ESA) monitors and verifies environmental compliance records for candidate venues. Primary duties include maintaining official municipal green building ratings, evaluating operational carbon intensity figures, and tracking waste diversion compliance across municipal audit frameworks.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: excluding off-site carbon offsets·Maintains municipal green building ratings, carbon intensity data, and waste diversion compliance（ECOL）
information_points.content:
ESA-ECOL-0U9：Evaluated excluding off-site carbon offsets, Pacific Point Convention Centre holds a certified Municipal green building standard under the current calendar year facility building performance index.
ESA-ECOL-J7N：Under the current calendar year facility building performance index evaluated excluding off-site carbon offsets, Granville Sound Exhibition Pavilion is certified under the Municipal green building standard.
ESA-ECOL-DV1：When assessed excluding off-site carbon offsets, Fraser Inlet Congress Complex is not certified under the Municipal green building standard according to the current calendar year facility building performance index.

information_points.title: including off-site carbon offsets·Maintains municipal green building ratings, carbon intensity data, and waste diversion compliance（WSTE）
information_points.content:
ESA-WSTE-0J3：Assessed including off-site carbon offsets under the current calendar year facility building performance index, Pacific Point Convention Centre is not certified under the Municipal green building standard.
ESA-WSTE-52Z：When evaluated including off-site carbon offsets in the current calendar year facility building performance index, Fraser Inlet Congress Complex does not hold a certified Municipal green building standard.
ESA-WSTE-YGK：Evaluated including off-site carbon offsets for the current calendar year facility building performance index, Granville Sound Exhibition Pavilion maintains certification under the Municipal green building standard.
